main_text.p: dotes a[?] proprio ordinentur epi-scopo, itaut cives & alii sacerdotes assensum praebeant. Item dist. 63. c. 11. Plebs, Presbyteros, diaconos & universam turbam vos (episcopos) oportet saepius convocare, quatenus non, prout cuilibet libuerit, sed concordantibus animis, vobis admonentibus, tale sibi quaerat persona, quam nulla contrarietas a constitutis possit revocare rescriptis. Item c. 13. episcopos per Æmiliam non con-secres, nisi post electionem vel consensum cleri & populi. cap. 19. Metropolitan. Omnium clericorum atque civium voluntate discussa, optimus ordinetur. cap. 20. sin plebibus. Archidiaconus cum clericis & populis ipsius plebis electionem faciat. c. 34. Sacrorum canonum. Carolus & Ludovicus Imperatores statuunt, ut episcopi per electionem cleri & populi secundum statuta canonum eligantur. Hunc ordinem etiam ponit Leo. page.notes: Printed page number 179 at the head. "à" in the first line is uncertain (printed with a superscript mark, read as a[?]). The italic marks on the references and on "Item" and "Metropolitan" are read from the scan and may be slightly off. Final "alij" is printed with j and is given as "alii" per the vowel rule. The line "vos (episcopos)" is printed with the parentheses shown.
